#!/bin/bash
# recover-tv-display.sh — Recover HDMI-A-1 (TV) output after hotplug blackscreen
# Usage: run from a TTY (Ctrl+Alt+F2) when the TV screen goes black and won't come back
#
# This does NOT restart the compositor. It forces KWin to re-evaluate outputs
# by toggling the HDMI-A-1 connector via sysfs and then restarting plasmashell's
# display config module.

set -euo pipefail

LOG="${HOME}/.local/state/omarchy/recover-tv-display.log"

log() {
  echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] $*" | tee -a "$LOG"
}

# Ensure log dir exists
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$LOG")"

log "=== TV display recovery started ==="

# 1. Check current state of HDMI-A-1
CONNECTOR="/sys/class/drm/card1-HDMI-A-1"
if [[ ! -d "$CONNECTOR" ]]; then
  log "ERROR: HDMI-A-1 connector not found at $CONNECTOR"
  log "Available connectors:"
  ls /sys/class/drm/ | grep -vE '^card$|render' | tee -a "$LOG"
  exit 1
fi

STATUS="$(cat "$CONNECTOR/status" 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown')"
log "HDMI-A-1 status: $STATUS"

# 2. Toggle the connector: write '0' then '1' to trigger a re-detect
# This is the same mechanism display managers use to re-probe EDID
if [[ -w "$CONNECTOR/power_mode" ]]; then
  log "Toggling power_mode..."
  echo "on" > "$CONNECTOR/power_mode" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

# Reset the connector by cycling the status through unbind/bind isn't safe from userspace.
# Instead, use the drm handle hotplug workaround: trigger a pending page flip or
# restart the output configuration via KWin/plasmashell.

# 3. Restart plasmashell display config — this re-reads kwinoutputconfig.json
# and re-applies the output layout without killing the compositor.
log "Restarting plasmashell display configuration..."
if command -v systemctl &>/dev/null && systemctl --user is-active plasmashell &>/dev/null; then
  systemctl --user restart plasmashell &>/dev/null || true
  log " plasmashell restart triggered"
else
  log " plasmashell not running as user service — skipping restart"
fi

# 4. Also try the KWin output management via DBus if available
if command -v qdbus &>/dev/null; then
  export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}"
  export DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS="unix:path=$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/bus"
  # Try to restart KWin's output handling
  if qdbus org.kde.KWin /Outputs 2>/dev/null; then
    log " KWin DBus output interface found"
  fi
fi

# 5. Force a mode refresh by pressing the virtual "refresh" via kscreen_doctor if available
if command -v kscreen_doctor &>/dev/null; then
  log "Running kscreen_doctor to re-apply config..."
  kscreen_doctor --apply-current 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG" || log "kscreen_doctor failed"
else
  log "kscreen_doctor not available — skipping"
fi

# 6. Wait a moment and check if HDMI-A-1 came back
sleep 3
NEW_STATUS="$(cat "$CONNECTOR/status" 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown')"
log "HDMI-A-1 status after recovery: $NEW_STATUS"

if [[ "$NEW_STATUS" == "connected" ]]; then
  log "SUCCESS: HDMI-A-1 is connected again"
else
  log "WARNING: HDMI-A-1 still not connected — may need full KWin restart"
  log "Try: loginctl terminate-user $(whoami)  (then re-login)"
fi

log "=== TV display recovery finished ==="
